summary: Backend fully validated (21/21 pytest passing) via /app/backend/tests/test_backend_api.py. Frontend E2E validated end-to-end: OTP login -> Home (hero + 3 country chips + 24 shops with clearbit logos, filter FR returns 8) -> Shop detail (calculator produces quote breakdown in FCFA) -> Add-to-Cart -> Cart summary -> Checkout -> Payment (Wave/Mobile Money) -> Order success modal -> Tracking screen (stepper + advance button rendered). Call-courier button is conditionally rendered when status=livreur_route (code confirmed at order/[id].tsx:135 and backend advance flow verified reaching livreur_route). No deprecated Expo packages detected. Only cosmetic console warnings observed: 'shadow*' style props and 'props.pointerEvents' deprecated in RN web (non-blocking, RN web warnings only).

issues: Wave payment button can be off-screen on 390x844 mobile viewport when 4 methods are laid out; requires scroll. Consider a 2x2 grid to keep all methods above the fold.

react_native_issues.issue: React Native Web logs 'shadow* style props are deprecated. Use boxShadow.' — replace shadowColor/shadowOffset/shadowOpacity/shadowRadius with the modern boxShadow shorthand or wrap in Platform.select. Non-blocking but pollutes console. Reference: multiple StyleSheet.create blocks across /app/frontend/app/*.tsx

React Native Web logs 'props.pointerEvents is deprecated. Use style.pointerEvents'. Non-blocking. Reference: likely inside expo-router / react-navigation dependencies; check any custom usage in /app/frontend/app.

action_items: (Optional/cosmetic) Migrate shadow* style props to boxShadow across styles to silence RN-Web deprecation warnings.
(Optional/UX) Rework payment method row on checkout so all 4 options (Orange/MTN/Moov/Wave) are visible without scrolling on 375-390px viewports (2x2 grid).
No blocking bugs found. All acceptance criteria pass.
critical_code_review_comments: server.py cart_summary(): total is recomputed inside the loop for each item (line ~452) — final value is correct because 'local' is added afterward, but the pattern is slightly confusing; consider moving 'total = sum(...)' after the loop. Not a functional bug.
server.py uses @app.on_event startup/shutdown which is deprecated in FastAPI 0.109+; consider migrating to lifespan handler. Non-blocking.
Frontend api.ts uses process.env.EXPO_PUBLIC_BACKEND_URL correctly. Token stored via SecureStore/AsyncStorage abstraction — good.
All interactive elements have proper testID coverage (login, home chips, shop cards, cart, checkout, tracking, profile).
No mongodb _id leakage detected (all queries include {"_id": 0} projection).
seed_data_creation: Backend startup automatically seeds 24 shops (SEED_SHOPS). Tests create TEST_-prefixed users, cart items and orders on the shared MongoDB; created data uses random ivorian phone numbers so it does not conflict with real users.
context_for_next_testing_agent: Public URL: https://cross-border-mall.preview.emergentagent.com. OTP=1234 for any phone. To run backend tests: `pytest /app/backend/tests/ -v`. Frontend uses testIDs consistently; a full happy-path Playwright script is in the iteration notes. On mobile viewport 390x844 the checkout page requires scroll to reach the Wave payment method — use scrollIntoView in tests.
rca_of_issue: N/A — no bugs found. All 21 backend endpoints return expected status codes and payloads. Frontend flow OTP -> home -> shop -> cart -> checkout -> pay -> success -> tracking succeeded end-to-end. Order status advance produced correct sequence (achat -> expedie -> en_transit -> arrive -> livreur_route -> livre).
